newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money unchanged in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money unchanged in liquid market.

text.p: *Volume swells to 18.332 bln from 7.539 bln pesos
Manila overnight money was unchanged at an average of 10.03125 percent on Monday amid high liquidity in the market, traders said.
Daily maturities of reverse repos kept banks very liquid even if they covered three days of weekend positions which bloated market volume, they said.
But the Central Bank has placed a floor on rates through its overnight borrowing rate of 10.0 percent, traders said.
Rates moved in a tight band from 10.0625 to 10.03125 percent, with 32 lenders and 21 borrowers.

Meanwhile, the Central Bank's withdrawal of its three-month special series T-bill rates signalled to the market that it wants the 91-day T-bill rate to move lower in the auction later on Monday, traders said. The special series would have placed a floor on the 91-day if it had not been withdrawn, they said.
Last Friday, the Central Bank cut its overnight borrowing rate by 0.25 percentage points to 10 percent.
The Central Bank's actions spurred buying of the three-month bills from other banks before the rates on these bills go lower.
